evidence.fact: Warriors: Charnze Nicoll-Klokstad returns from suspension; Te Maire Martin and Chanel Harris-Tavita return from hamstring injuries. Leka Halasima is out with an ankle injury; Taine Tuaupiki moves to fullback and Jett Cleary to the bench. Wayde Egan and Kurt Capewell are rested; Sam Healey starts at hooker and Eddie Ieremia-Toeava starts.

Sea Eagles retain the same starting side from their win over the Dragons; Onitoni Large remains on the interchange. Friday 24-hour update removed Nic Lenaz and Hugo Hart and added Jackson Shereb to the interchange.
Warriors entered Round 27 first on 40 competition points with +309 points differential and are pursuing the minor premiership; Sea Eagles are out of finals contention.

Warriors: Martin return: UP with return-from-hamstring uncertainty
Harris-Tavita return: UP with return-from-hamstring uncertainty
Egan rested: DOWN for established hooker continuity; finals-management benefit not counted toward this match
Capewell rested: DOWN for established edge experience
